```{r}
load("MAY.MG.recluster.obj.Rdata")
```



```{r}
DefaultAssay(MG.recluster.obj) <- "RNA"
```

```{r}
p <- VlnPlot(MG.recluster.obj, features = c("Fn1","Ccl2","Ccl5","Ccl12","Apoe"),
             pt.size = 0, group.by = "state_anno", ncol = 5)
ggsave("./Figure_Final/Figure5/violin_plots.pdf", plot = p, width = 12, height = 3)
```
